comments.author: Campbell
comments.content: That is very cool, looking forward to trying it out.

comments.author: veryalien
comments.content:
Very nice indeed! Using an Android smartphone and it's very easy to use the interface. Now guessing the correct commands with the parser isn't a problem any more....unless, of course, the writer of the adventure wants to make it difficult and not add all the commands as clickable selections (I assume that is possible? - I'm not a Quest expert so far!)
Will the convertion to javascript and "app builder" be included as part of the standard Quest package?

comments.author: Alex Warren
comments.content:
Generally all the objects will be clickable, but it's up to the author to add the verbs they want to display (they're the "Display verbs" in the object editor).

App building and JS conversion won't be part of the standard Quest package, as there's a bit of manual work to be done for each game, and also it gives me an opportunity to do any customisations that might be necessary - I think it's important for each released app to be good, I don't want to see the Android market flooded with poor quality text adventure games for example.
